name: Shizuki's Presence
description: Two different Fae activations awaken Shizuki's Presence once per battle, restoring HP and Mana and empowering the next damaging spell. Low-Mana Evocation overflows Mana to 150% of its normal maximum.
levelUpLine: lvl 48 Mastery 🌿 Shizuki's Presence: When two different Fae abilities activate during the same battle, Shizuki's Presence awakens once per battle, restoring 30 HP and 40 Mana and empowering your next offensive spell with +3 to its offensive roll and +15 damage. Casting Evocation below 25% Mana causes it to overflow your Mana to 150% of its maximum.
convergenceFlavor: The Fae gather around you, their magic suddenly moving in perfect harmony.
Two traces of Fae magic intertwine. For just a moment, something about it feels strangely familiar.
The Fae suddenly grow quiet. Their magic gathers around you as though following a path they somehow remember.
The Fae exchange knowing glances before their magic begins to resonate around you.
Two different Fae magics collide, but instead of dispersing, they begin moving as one.
The Fae circle closer. For a fleeting moment, you get the strange feeling that you've stood here before.
evocationFlavor: Your remaining Mana flickers—and something answers. Evocation surges far beyond its usual limit.
Evocation should have stopped. It doesn't. Mana continues pouring through you long after your reserves are full.
The familiar flow of Evocation suddenly changes. For a moment, the magic feels like it belongs to someone else.
The Fae watch silently as Evocation surges past its natural limit. Strangely, none of them seem surprised.
